plan.title: Recreate Order available on live RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with two bids instead of creating or searching for another event.
Ensure eRFX projects are enabled for the tenant as required by the setup.
Assert that the stage Settings menu offers Recreate Order and that it is clickable.
Select Recreate Order to verify that its window opens without confirming any change.
Assert that the Recreate Order window is open.
Cancel the window so no order recreation is performed.
Assert that cancelling closes the Recreate Order window.
